newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, nearby months up.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, nearby months up.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures closed mixed on Monday, as short covering by individual investors supported nearby months, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.7 yen lower to 0.2 yen higher, with the benchmark June contract down 0.6 yen at 147.3 yen per kg. The day's volume was 8,931 lots.
"Some local investors actively covered short positions at the spot all day," a brokerage house analyst said.
The spot January month, which expires next Monday, had 6,289 lots of positions as of last Friday. "Nearbys will fluctuate this week on position adjustment," a trader said.
